notes: Account summary: Large North American ecommerce platform (2k+ stores). Heavy multilingual support — EN, ES, FR, DE, PT-BR. Looking to consolidate vendor stack for agent assist + translation + automated ticket summarization.

Business need: Reduce AHT (average handle time) and speed up 1st response for tier-1 chat by surfacing suggested replies, pre-filled macros, and automated ticket summaries for handoffs. Also need automated tool-calling to update order status and open refunds in their monolith via API calls.

Traffic profile: baseline 12k concurrent chats during peak, spikes to ~95k concurrent during sale events (Black Friday windows). Concerned about graceful degradation and deterministic fallbacks — cannot drop chat volume.

Performance targets: agent-assist latency target 200-350ms for suggestion tokens; end-to-end tool-call orchestration (prompt -> model -> webhook) under 800ms typical; summarization jobs can be async but should complete within 10s for SLA cases.

Model preferences: prefer a regional model with strong multilingual quality. Interested in Redwood's vetted open models + quantized variants for cost, but want fallbacks (smaller models) when dedicated capacity saturated.

Routing/fallback policy ask: auto-route EU traffic to EU data residency model; fallback to hosted multi-tenant in same region if dedicated pool exhausted; circuit-breaker if queue > threshold with degraded reply template.

Security/compliance: must have SSO/SAML for console, SOC2 attestation, encryption at rest with KMS, audit logs for all model calls, and 1-year retention controls + ability to redaction PII on ingest. Legal insists on EU data residency for EU customer data.

POC scope agreed: 1) agent-assist pipeline in Zendesk via Redwood streaming responses + tool-calls to order system (sandbox); 2) ticket summarization batch job for last 30 days of tickets (10k items) to validate cost & quality; 3) burst test simulating 5x normal traffic to measure autoscale and latency fallbacks.
POC success metrics: subjective agent satisfaction >= 4/5 on internal survey; AHT reduction >= 18% on pilot queues; summarization ROUGE/recall threshold to be defined by their QA team next week.

Integrations: Zendesk + internal order API (GraphQL), Segment for telemetry, Snowflake for embeddings store. Plan to use Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching & quantization profiles after initial runs.
